name: cogentstack
description: Open CogentStack, securely authorize ChatGPT Desktop, build explicitly approved server-generated projects, and execute project-folder deletions explicitly confirmed in the hosted workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Open, build, and safely manage CogentStack projects.
interface.longDescription: CogentStack opens the hosted workspace at cogentstack.app, supports user-approved Desktop authorization, turns natural-language briefs into explicitly approved projects through verified server-generated artifacts, and executes project-folder deletion only after exact hosted confirmation. Project Type Contracts, blueprints, compatibility rules, licence validation, and subscriber data remain on the protected CogentStack service.
defaultPrompt: Sign in to CogentStack from Desktop.
Build the approved project I describe in this composer.
Delete the project I explicitly approved for deletion in CogentStack.
